notes.title: Servo Beta 5 Lands on Steam
notes.notes:
Suit up, Servo Pilots! It's been a long time coming, and we thank you for your patience while the team has been working hard behind the scenes to bring you this update! [b]As of today, Beta 5 is now available on Steam for all Servo pilots. [/b]There are some new pre-game backgrounds, some UI improvements to the hanger, and a whole bunch of new Servo parts![b] [/b]Check out the full change log below.
 
 [b]Here's what's changed:[/b]

[b][ Graphics ][/b][list][*]Added new pre-game backgrounds[*]Updated Orbital Strike to have three versions[*]Updated pilot icons[*]Added new Creep icons[*]Added new building summoning fx[*]Added new Hyena drone art[*]Added building explosion gibs[/list]

[b][ UI ][/b][list][*]Made various fixes and improvements to the Hanger UI, including part comparison[*]Pre-game UI performance improvements made[*]Added post-game stats page[*]Many mini-map improvements[/list]

[b][ Gameplay ][/b][list][*]Updated the Quagmire map layout to be more balanced and fixed incorrect camera limits[*]Added lots of new Servo parts[*]Improved the post-game flow[*]Replaced Kira's old ability for a new Rage power[*]Various fixes to the training missions[*]Various balance updates for part costs[*]Balance updates to Creeps (fewer HP), Turrets (cheaper / more DPS) and Servos (faster movement)[*]Meteors now drop in clockwise fasion in Degrees co-op[*]AI made less difficult[*]Dialogues updated for the story missions[*]Some story missions made easier to complete[*]Creep holes now produce different critters[*]Added shield walls to the campaign levels[*]Setup initial achievements[*]Drones and Creeps should overlap less when moving[/list]

[b][ Audio ][/b][list][*]Added various new/update sound fx for the UI, abilities and weapons[*]Added new music tracks[/list]

[b][ Misc ][/b][list][*]Various string fixes[*]Various bug fixes[/list]

notes.title: Servo Beta 3 Released
notes.notes:
Beta 3 includes the Early Access Care Package with over 20 parts, credits, and scrap for players to spend. Servos now have a build radius around them which allows players to construct buildings anywhere and new parts that you can equip with new abilities such as making turrets cheaper or give certain drones more hitpoints.

This update also has many bug fixes and improvements to the game. We appreciate the continued feedback from the Servo community.

You can see the 3.0 beta changelog here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/305510/discussions/1/541907867764271437/

Be sure to check us out each Tuesday at 5pm ET (2pm Pacific) for the [url=http://www.twitch.tv/stardock]Servo livestream on Twitch[/url]. Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Servogame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/servogame]Facebook [/url]to stay updated with other news and happenings with Servo.

notes.title: Servo Beta 2 Released
notes.notes:
Servo Beta 2 update is now available! In this update we have new content including a Juggernaut servo, Medusa Bloomspawn, new Tempered Jungle map, and tons of improvements to existing campaign missions. We also added a new mix-and-match weapon system for even more Servo customization. Level up your pilots and gear even faster with the new post game reward and level system!

The update has a bunch of bug fixes and improvements. We appreciate the continued feedback from the Servo community.

You can see the 2.0 beta changelog here: http://forums.servogame.com/467563/

Be sure to check us out each Tuesday at 3pm ET (Noon Pacific) for the [url=http://www.twitch.tv/stardock]Servo livestream on Twitch[/url]. Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Servogame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/servogame]Facebook[/url] to stay updated with other news and happenings with Servo.

notes.title: Servo 1.1 Beta Released
notes.notes:
The next beta update for Servo is now available! The 1.1 beta update brings a couple of work in progress maps (PVP and Co-Op), new Attack move, a new campaign dialog system, and several other new features that have been added to the game.

We’ve also been fixing bugs and other issues that have been reported, and we really appreciate the community feedback we’ve been getting for Servo.

You can see the full v1.1 changelog here: http://forums.servogame.com/467099/

Keep the feedback coming on the forums, and be sure to check us out each Tuesday at 3pm ET (Noon Pacific) for the Servo livestream on Twitch.
